bio: Data Engineer with 5+ years building data lake infrastructure, streaming pipelines, and dimensional warehouse models on AWS. I own a layered S3 data lake and the streaming path behind it, moving 12M+ supply-chain events per day into a multi-billion-row Redshift warehouse with registry-backed schema validation, checkpointed exactly-once writes, and a 15-minute freshness SLA.

Migrated a 50-workflow Informatica estate to Airflow as 180+ restartable tasks, rebuilt pricing and supply-chain marts with conformed dimensions, SCD Type 2, and CDC incremental loads, and added data quality checks gating 200+ production tables. Cut P95 runtime on the top-20 reports from 38 minutes to 5.
